name: EH3D-PNP-MANAGER
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.4: a library and a command line for pick and place assembly: they read the position file of a board (KiCad .pos or a CSV from another CAD program, in mm, mil or inches), give every part the feeder that holds its value and package, report the parts without a feeder and the feeders that will run out, and plan the order of the placements for a head with one to six nozzles, with the bottom side mirrored, as a JSON job. No window, no camera and no machine control; nothing has placed a part.
